name: AI team · fast with a mutation check
summary: The fast team, plus a mutation check once the tests pass: the system makes small mistakes in the code on purpose, and QA adds hidden tests for the ones its suite missed. Tests whether stronger hidden tests catch bugs the first suite let through.
steps: Builder plans and codes, QA writes hidden tests (at the same time)
System runs both test sets → Builder fixes if failing (max 5 rounds)
Mutation check: missed mistakes go to QA, its new tests run on the code → Builder fixes
